targets.rawSql:
WITH state_map(state, code) AS (
  VALUES
    ('IDLE', 1),
    ('VENTILATE', 2),
    ('THERMAL_RELIEF', 3),
    ('DEHUM_VENT', 4),
    ('SEALED_MIST_S1', 5),
    ('SEALED_MIST_S2', 6),
    ('SEALED_MIST_FOG', 7),
    ('SEALED_MIST_WATCH', 8),
    ('TEMP_IDLE_HUM_IDLE', 9),
    ('TEMP_IDLE_HUMID_S1', 10),
    ('TEMP_IDLE_VPD_WATCH', 11),
    ('HEAT_S1_HUM_IDLE', 12),
    ('HEAT_S1_HUMID_S1', 13),
    ('HEAT_S1_VPD_WATCH', 14),
    ('HEAT_S2_HUM_IDLE', 15),
    ('HEAT_S2_HUMID_S1', 16),
    ('HEAT_S2_VPD_WATCH', 17),
    ('COOL_S1_HUM_IDLE', 18),
    ('COOL_S1_HUMID_S1', 19),
    ('COOL_S1_HUMID_S2', 20),
    ('COOL_S1_VPD_WATCH', 21),
    ('COOL_S2_HUMID_S1', 22),
    ('COOL_S2_HUMID_S2', 23),
    ('SAFETY_COOL', 24)
)
SELECT
  now() AS time,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT sm.code
    FROM v_greenhouse_now g
    LEFT JOIN state_map sm ON sm.state = g.state
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS "State";

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, solar_irradiance_w_m2 AS "Solar" FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

(SELECT ts AS time, solar_irradiance_w_m2 AS "Solar Forecast"
FROM climate WHERE solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (date_trunc('hour', ts))
    date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, solar_w_m2 AS "Solar Forecast"
FROM weather_forecast WHERE ts > now() AND ts < now() + interval '72 hours'
ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', ts), fetched_at DESC)

SELECT ts AS time,
    temp_low + f.frac * (temp_target - temp_low) AS "Target Band Base",
    temp_high - f.frac * (temp_high - temp_target) AS "Target Band",

FROM v_band_curve,
     (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setpoint_snapshot WHERE parameter='band_track_fraction' AND greenhouse_id='vallery' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), 0.25) AS frac) f
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
    avg(temp_avg) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Greenhouse"
FROM climate
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, outdoor_temp_f AS "Outdoor"
FROM climate
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts

(SELECT ts AS time, outdoor_temp_f AS "Outdoor Forecast"
 FROM climate WHERE outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL

     date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time,

 FROM weather_forecast
 WHERE ts > now() AND ts < now() + interval '72 hours'
 ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', ts), fetched_at DESC)

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 93.0::float8 ELSE 90.6::float8 END AS "Vent", 90.6::float8 AS "Vent Base" FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment='vent' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 95.8::float8 ELSE 93.4::float8 END AS "Fan 1", 93.4::float8 AS "Fan 1 Base" FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment='fan1' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 98.6::float8 ELSE 96.2::float8 END AS "Fan 2", 96.2::float8 AS "Fan 2 Base" FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment='fan2' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 101.4::float8 ELSE 99.0::float8 END AS "Fog", 99.0::float8 AS "Fog Base" FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment='fog' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

WITH ev AS (SELECT ts, equipment, state FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment IN ('mister_center', 'mister_south', 'mister_west') AND $__timeFilter(ts)), pts AS (SELECT DISTINCT ts FROM ev), merged AS (SELECT p.ts AS ts, bool_or(COALESCE(l.state,false)) AS on FROM pts p CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('mister_center'), ('mister_south'), ('mister_west')) k(key) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.state FROM ev e WHERE e.equipment=k.key AND e.ts<=p.ts ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true GROUP BY p.ts) SELECT $__time(m.ts), CASE WHEN m.on THEN 104.2::float8 ELSE 101.8::float8 END AS "Misters", 101.8::float8 AS "Misters Base" FROM merged m ORDER BY m.ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 54.4::float8 ELSE 52.0::float8 END AS "Heat 1 (Electric)", 52.0::float8 AS "Heat 1 (Electric) Base" FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment='heat1' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 50.8::float8 ELSE 48.4::float8 END AS "Heat 2 (Gas)", 48.4::float8 AS "Heat 2 (Gas) Base" FROM equipment_state WHERE greenhouse_id='vallery' AND equipment='heat2' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.description: Heat 2 relay runtime converted to therms per minute with a 30-minute trailing average, overlaid with 30-minute average solar radiation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS raw_from_ts,
    ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes') AS from_ts,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), events AS (
  SELECT from_ts AS ts,
         COALESCE((SELECT state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='heat2' AND ts <= from_ts ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), false) AS state
  FROM bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT es.ts, es.state
  FROM equipment_state es, bounds
  WHERE es.equipment='heat2' AND es.ts > bounds.from_ts AND es.ts < bounds.to_ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_ts, false FROM bounds
), intervals AS (
  SELECT ts AS start_ts, lead(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS end_ts, state
  FROM events
), buckets AS (
  SELECT gs AS bucket_start, gs + interval '1 minute' AS bucket_end
  FROM bounds, generate_series(time_bucket('1 minute', from_ts), to_ts, interval '1 minute') AS gs
), minute_rates AS (
  SELECT b.bucket_start AS time,
         (SUM(
           CASE
             WHEN i.start_ts IS NULL OR i.end_ts IS NULL THEN 0
             ELSE GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM LEAST(i.end_ts, b.bucket_end) - GREATEST(i.start_ts, b.bucket_start)), 0) / 3600.0
           END
         ) * 75000 / 100000) AS therms_per_min
  FROM buckets b
  LEFT JOIN intervals i
    ON i.state IS TRUE
   AND i.end_ts IS NOT NULL
   AND i.start_ts < b.bucket_end
   AND i.end_ts > b.bucket_start
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
), smoothed AS (
  SELECT time,
         AVG(therms_per_min) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS therms_per_min_30m
  FROM minute_rates
)
SELECT time,
       ROUND(therms_per_min_30m::numeric, 5) AS "Gas 30-min avg (therms/min)"
FROM smoothed, bounds
WHERE time >= bounds.raw_from_ts
ORDER BY time

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS raw_from_ts,
    ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes') AS from_ts,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
), minute_rates AS (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS time,
         AVG(solar_irradiance_w_m2) AS solar_w_m2
  FROM climate, bounds
  WHERE ts >= bounds.from_ts
    AND ts <= bounds.to_ts
    AND solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
), smoothed AS (
  SELECT time,
         AVG(solar_w_m2) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS solar_w_m2_30m
  FROM minute_rates
)
SELECT time,
       ROUND(solar_w_m2_30m::numeric, 0) AS "Solar 30-min avg (W/m²)"
FROM smoothed, bounds
WHERE time >= bounds.raw_from_ts
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Two independent grow-light circuits (overhead/orchid + hydro grow). Per-circuit relay-state lanes (dots-fixed), per-circuit lux switch-threshold bands, and observed/forecast solar lux.

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw_bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
),
bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT GREATEST(from_ts, to_ts - interval '7 days') AS from_ts, to_ts AS to_ts,
    LEAST(to_ts, now()) AS state_to_ts, interval '10 minutes' AS step
  FROM raw_bounds
),
solar_actual AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT time_bucket((SELECT step FROM bounds), c.ts) AS time, 'Solar'::text AS metric,
    avg(COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux))::double precision AS value
  FROM climate c
  WHERE c.ts >= (SELECT from_ts FROM bounds) AND c.ts <= (SELECT state_to_ts FROM bounds)
    AND COALESCE(c.outdoor_lux, c.lux) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
solar_forecast_seed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT time, 'Solar Forecast'::text AS metric, value FROM solar_actual
  WHERE (SELECT to_ts FROM bounds) > (SELECT state_to_ts FROM bounds)
  ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
),
solar_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (time_bucket((SELECT step FROM bounds), wf.ts))
    time_bucket((SELECT step FROM bounds), wf.ts) AS time, 'Solar Forecast'::text AS metric,
    (wf.solar_w_m2 * 120.0)::double precision AS value
  FROM weather_forecast wf
  WHERE wf.ts > (SELECT state_to_ts FROM bounds) AND wf.ts >= (SELECT from_ts FROM bounds)
    AND wf.ts <= (SELECT to_ts FROM bounds) AND wf.solar_w_m2 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY time_bucket((SELECT step FROM bounds), wf.ts), wf.fetched_at DESC
)
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT time, metric, value FROM solar_actual
  UNION ALL SELECT time, metric, value FROM solar_forecast_seed
  UNION ALL SELECT time, metric, value FROM solar_forecast
) series
ORDER BY time,
  CASE metric WHEN 'Solar' THEN 0 WHEN 'Solar Forecast' THEN 1
    ELSE 2 END, metric

WITH raw_bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
),
bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT GREATEST(from_ts, to_ts - interval '7 days') AS from_ts, to_ts AS to_ts,
    LEAST(to_ts, now()) AS state_to_ts,
    date_trunc('hour', GREATEST(from_ts, to_ts - interval '7 days')) AS seed_start_ts,
    interval '10 minutes' AS step
  FROM raw_bounds
),
policy AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    greatest(100.0, least(100000.0, COALESCE(
      max(p.lux_on_threshold) FILTER (WHERE p.light_key='main'),
      40000.0))) AS main_on,
    greatest(0.0, least(25000.0, COALESCE(
      max(p.lux_hysteresis) FILTER (WHERE p.light_key='main'),
      8000.0))) AS main_hyst,
    greatest(100.0, least(100000.0, COALESCE(
      max(p.lux_on_threshold) FILTER (WHERE p.light_key='grow'),
      40000.0))) AS grow_on,
    greatest(0.0, least(25000.0, COALESCE(
      max(p.lux_hysteresis) FILTER (WHERE p.light_key='grow'),
      8000.0))) AS grow_hyst
  FROM bounds bd
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL fn_lighting_circuit_policy(bd.state_to_ts, 'vallery') p
),
policy_wide AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    main_on,
    main_on + main_hyst AS main_off,
    grow_on,
    grow_on + grow_hyst AS grow_off
  FROM policy
),
buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(time_bucket(b.step, b.seed_start_ts), LEAST(b.to_ts, now()), b.step) AS time FROM bounds b
),
lane_metrics AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *
  FROM policy_wide p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    (
      'grow_light_main'::text,
      'Overhead Light'::text,
      p.main_on + GREATEST(250.0, (p.main_off - p.main_on) * 0.47)
    ),
    (
      'grow_light_grow'::text,
      'Grow Light'::text,
      p.grow_off
    )
  ) AS m(equipment, metric, value_when_on)
),
state_seed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT bd.seed_start_ts AS time, m.equipment, COALESCE(seed.state, false) AS state
  FROM bounds bd CROSS JOIN lane_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT e.state
    FROM equipment_state e
    WHERE e.greenhouse_id='vallery' AND e.equipment=m.equipment AND e.ts <= bd.seed_start_ts
    ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 1
  ) seed ON true
),
state_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.ts AS time, e.equipment, e.state
  FROM equipment_state e, bounds bd
  WHERE e.greenhouse_id='vallery'
    AND e.equipment IN ('grow_light_main','grow_light_grow')
    AND e.ts >= bd.seed_start_ts
    AND e.ts <= bd.state_to_ts
),
state_timeline AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.time, e.equipment, e.state,
    lead(e.time,1,(SELECT state_to_ts FROM bounds)) OVER (PARTITION BY e.equipment ORDER BY e.time) AS next_time
  FROM (SELECT time,equipment,state FROM state_seed UNION ALL SELECT time,equipment,state FROM state_events) e
),
state_segments AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT greatest(st.time, bd.seed_start_ts) AS start_time, least(st.next_time, bd.state_to_ts) AS end_time, st.equipment
  FROM state_timeline st CROSS JOIN bounds bd
  WHERE st.state AND st.time < bd.state_to_ts AND st.next_time > bd.seed_start_ts
),
lanes AS (
  SELECT b.time, m.metric,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM state_segments s
      WHERE s.equipment=m.equipment
        AND s.start_time < b.time + bd.step
        AND s.end_time > b.time
    ) THEN m.value_when_on ELSE NULL::double precision END AS value
  FROM buckets b CROSS JOIN bounds bd CROSS JOIN lane_metrics m
  WHERE b.time >= bd.from_ts AND b.time <= bd.state_to_ts
)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM lanes ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Lighting: Overhead vs Grow Circuit — Lux & Switch State

panels.description: Per-zone air temperatures (labeled by crop) against the shared on-chip house temperature band (green envelope = low..high) and the house target center line. Band renders 24h forward; zone lines are past-only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
    temp_low + f.frac * (temp_target - temp_low) AS "House Band Base",
    temp_high - f.frac * (temp_high - temp_target) AS "House Band",
    temp_target AS "House Target"
FROM v_band_curve,
     (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT value FROM setpoint_snapshot WHERE parameter='band_track_fraction' AND greenhouse_id='vallery' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), 0.25) AS frac) f
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(temp_north) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "North"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_north IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(temp_south) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "South (Cannabis)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_south IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(temp_west) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "West (Lime)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_west IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(temp_east) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "East (Pepper)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_east IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(temp_avg) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Center (Vanda)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND temp_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Zone Temperature vs House Band

panels.description: Per-zone vapour-pressure deficit (solid, by crop) each against ITS OWN target curve (dashed, matched color) from fn_zone_vpd_targets: South=Cannabis (driest), West=Lime, East=Pepper, Center=Vanda (lowest). Targets render 24h forward.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,
    vpd_target_south AS "South Target",
    vpd_target_west AS "West Target",
    vpd_target_east AS "East Target",
    vpd_target_center AS "Center Target"
FROM v_band_curve WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(vpd_north) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "North"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND vpd_north IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(vpd_south) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "South (Cannabis)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND vpd_south IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(vpd_west) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "West (Lime)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND vpd_west IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  avg(vpd_east) OVER (ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "East (Pepper)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ts <= now() AND vpd_east IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Zone VPD vs Per-Zone Targets

panels.description: Firmware arbitration view: normalized temp & VPD deltas (0 = on target, ±1 = band edge — the dimensionless temp-vs-VPD 'equality statement', bigger |Δ| wins). Faint green = in-band (|Δ|<1). FSM state family lane at top (Heat/Cool-Vent/Mist-Fog/Idle from system_state). Actuals stop at now; the in-band reference renders ±72h forward.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b.ts AS time,
  GREATEST(-2.5, LEAST(2.5, (c.temp_avg - b.temp_target)/GREATEST(0.5,(b.temp_high-b.temp_low)/2)))::float AS "Norm Temp Δ",
  GREATEST(-2.5, LEAST(2.5, (c.vpd_avg - b.vpd_target)/GREATEST(0.05,(b.vpd_high-b.vpd_low)/2)))::float AS "Norm VPD Δ"
FROM v_band_curve b
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT avg(temp_avg) AS temp_avg, avg(vpd_avg) AS vpd_avg FROM climate
  WHERE ts >= b.ts AND ts < b.ts + interval '15 minutes' AND temp_avg IS NOT NULL AND vpd_avg IS NOT NULL
) c ON c.temp_avg IS NOT NULL
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.ts) AND b.ts <= now()
ORDER BY b.ts

SELECT g.ts AS time,
  (-1.0)::float AS "In-Band Low",
  ( 1.0)::float AS "In-Band High",
  ( 0.0)::float AS "On Target"
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '15 minutes') g(ts)
ORDER BY g.ts

WITH raw_bounds AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS from_ts, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS to_ts
),
bounds AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT from_ts, to_ts, LEAST(to_ts, now()) AS state_to_ts,
    date_trunc('hour', from_ts) AS seed_start_ts, interval '10 minutes' AS step
  FROM raw_bounds
),
buckets AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT generate_series(time_bucket(b.step, b.seed_start_ts), LEAST(b.to_ts, now()), b.step) AS time FROM bounds b
),
families AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Heat'::text,     'State Heat'::text,     'State Heat Base'::text),
    ('Cool/Vent'::text,'State Cool/Vent'::text,'State Cool/Vent Base'::text),
    ('Mist/Fog'::text, 'State Mist/Fog'::text, 'State Mist/Fog Base'::text),
    ('Idle'::text,     'State Idle'::text,     'State Idle Base'::text)
  ) AS f(family, top_metric, base_metric)
),
state_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ss.ts AS time,
    CASE
      WHEN ss.value ILIKE '%HEAT%' THEN 'Heat'
      WHEN ss.value ILIKE '%COOL%' OR ss.value ILIKE '%VENT%' OR ss.value ILIKE '%THERMAL%' OR ss.value ILIKE '%SAFETY%' THEN 'Cool/Vent'
      WHEN ss.value ILIKE '%MIST%' OR ss.value ILIKE '%FOG%' OR ss.value ILIKE '%HUMID%' THEN 'Mist/Fog'
      ELSE 'Idle'
    END AS family
  FROM system_state ss, bounds bd
  WHERE ss.entity='greenhouse_state' AND ss.greenhouse_id='vallery'
    AND ss.ts >= bd.seed_start_ts AND ss.ts <= bd.state_to_ts
),
state_seed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT bd.seed_start_ts AS time,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT CASE
        WHEN s.value ILIKE '%HEAT%' THEN 'Heat'
        WHEN s.value ILIKE '%COOL%' OR s.value ILIKE '%VENT%' OR s.value ILIKE '%THERMAL%' OR s.value ILIKE '%SAFETY%' THEN 'Cool/Vent'
        WHEN s.value ILIKE '%MIST%' OR s.value ILIKE '%FOG%' OR s.value ILIKE '%HUMID%' THEN 'Mist/Fog'
        ELSE 'Idle' END
      FROM system_state s WHERE s.entity='greenhouse_state' AND s.greenhouse_id='vallery' AND s.ts <= bd.seed_start_ts
      ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'Idle') AS family
  FROM bounds bd
),
timeline AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.time, e.family,
    lead(e.time,1,(SELECT state_to_ts FROM bounds)) OVER (ORDER BY e.time) AS next_time
  FROM (SELECT time, family FROM state_seed UNION ALL SELECT time, family FROM state_events) e
),
lanes AS (
  SELECT b.time, f.top_metric AS metric,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timeline t WHERE t.family=f.family AND t.time < b.time + bd.step AND t.next_time > b.time)
      THEN 3.0 ELSE 2.8 END AS value
  FROM buckets b CROSS JOIN bounds bd CROSS JOIN families f WHERE b.time >= bd.from_ts AND b.time <= bd.state_to_ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.time, f.base_metric, 2.8 FROM buckets b CROSS JOIN bounds bd CROSS JOIN families f WHERE b.time >= bd.from_ts AND b.time <= bd.state_to_ts
)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM lanes ORDER BY time, metric
